**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching restriction on Bluefly. § 14.8 "Personnel" — the expected home of such a covenant — deals only with supervision, IBM's right to assign its own personnel, and subcontracting; § 14.16 "Freedom of Action" further confirms each party may contract freely with others. Searches for "solicit", "hire", "recruit", "employ", "induce", and restrictive-covenant language returned nothing operative. No redline proposed.
